title: Code for: The Value of Health Information in Couples' Annuity Choice: A Dyadic Mortality Model, an Exact Benchmark, and Explainable Reinforcement Learning
description: Code that produces every result, table and figure of the article: the cohort of couples built from the RAND HRS Longitudinal File, a Bayesian mortality model of couples and its assessment, the couple's annuity decision solved by dynamic programming with exact expectations, two reinforcement learning agents, and Shapley-value and decision-tree explanations of the annuity decision. No data are included: the HRS conditions of use do not permit the transfer of the data to third parties, and the scripts build the analysis files from the original RAND HRS file.
